q1_issues.issue: (Member un organization) asserts a kind no word in the text supplies - 'U.N.' appears only as a bare name, so the typing is world knowledge, which Core patterns bars.

'the new decisions' is a DEFINITE PLURAL but is encoded as a single witness sk_decision_1; the plural rules require a group witness (GroupOf) with the property distributed, so the count of the referent is lost.

(From sk_assistance_1 un) supplies a preposition the text never uses - 'U.N. assistance' is a bare noun-noun compound, and the oblique rule insists the head be the preposition actually used, never a near-fit synonym.
The coordinated objects 'assistance and advice' are hung on ONE need event as two Stimulus atoms, whereas coordinated NPs are distributive by default (replicate the predication once per conjunct).

The attitude holder takes Agent while the Propositional attitudes section prescribes Experiencer for the holder of a sealed-complement attitude; 'tell' sits between that rule and the progressive test in Thematic roles, and the parse follows the latter without the section that governs the construction.

q2_gaps: attributive PROPER-NOUN modifier ('U.N. assistance and advice' = assistance from the U.N.): a noun-noun compound whose modifier is a proper noun is excluded from Compound concepts and is not a genitive, so it has no licensed encoding

direct quotation embedded inside reported speech (the quote marks around 'need U.N. assistance ... which have been taken', with 'on organising ...' outside the quote): quotation / mixed direct-indirect speech is nowhere addressed, so the quote boundary is simply ignored

a three-argument speech verb with BOTH an addressee and a clausal complement ('told him that P'): Propositional attitudes gives the holder Experiencer, Thematic roles' progressive test gives a speech verb Agent, and nothing says which wins

light-verb + event-noun beyond occur/happen/take place ('decisions ... have been taken'): the Time section's light-verb rule names only occur/happen/took place, so it is unclear whether 'take a decision' should reify a separate take event or put the status on the decision witness
notes: Sealing the complement under Theme with the definite 'decisions' typing projected to top level, the nationality-adjective fusions iraqi_leader / iraqi_government with genus but no modifier genus, the Recipient on 'him', and 'by June' as TimeAtMost (Month june) are all correct. The whole sealed proposition is one flat (And ...), which the multi-atom-complement rule licenses.
